name: tama
description: Your own Markdown notes, searchable and writable from the terminal.

server_url.title: Tama server address
server_url.description: Where your Tama server answers. Keep the default if it runs on this machine; otherwise use the address `tama expose` printed. Claude Code dials it from here, so a private tailnet address works.

device_token.title: Device token
device_token.description: Run `tama-server connect claude-code` where Tama runs and paste what it prints - it fills in this field and the address together. On a Docker deployment the command is `tama connect`. Shown once. Add `--as AUDIENCE` for a read-only slice of the vault, but note that recording a session then refuses.

auto_save.title: Record every session automatically
auto_save.description: When a session ends, send its transcript to your Tama server, which summarises it and files an entry in the project's log - or files nothing, which is the usual outcome. Off by default: it costs one model call per session on your own key, and your prompts and Claude's replies leave this machine for your server.
